officialFormName: AOC-334, Order Voiding Conviction and Sealing Records, Rev. 1-22
issuingAuthority: Kentucky Administrative Office of the Courts
acquisitionNote: The registry records the form title, revision and a direct kycourts.gov URL, retrieved 2026-08-06, with sha256 null. No copy of AOC-334 is in the Kentucky Nationwide inventory: the committed state pack's officialFormInventory holds only seven files (AOC-496.2, AOC-496.3, AOC-497.2, Kentucky-Expungement-Reference.pdf, JV-29, JV-29.1, JV-30), with two HTML reference files carried separately in its resourcePacketInventory. The compiled KY profile does not mention AOC-334 anywhere.
sharedWithTrackNote: The registry records the identical officialFormId and officialSourceUrl on both Kentucky void-and-seal tracks. One acquisition and one field map serve both, but the form must be correctly parameterised for the KRS 218A.275 branch and the KRS 218A.276 branch.
draftingProhibitedBecause: It is an official Kentucky AOC form, and it is a court order. Lane C drafts no official forms and drafts no order text; overlay and field-map ownership sits with the official-PDF overlay lane. Drafting a substitute order would invent the operative terms of a sealing order, including which record custodians it binds.
blockingStatement: The packet cannot be assembled for filing until AOC-334 is acquired at its current revision and field-mapped. The motion is drafted and complete; the tendered order is not, and the recorded filing rule requires it to be tendered with the motion.
owningLane: lane-D/E official-PDF overlay and official-source acquisition
exactMissingSource: AOC-334, Order Voiding Conviction and Sealing Records, Rev. 1-22 — the PDF itself at https://www.kycourts.gov/Legal-Forms/Legal%20Forms/334.pdf, plus a captured sha256 and a field map. No copy is on file in the Kentucky Nationwide inventory and no hash is recorded.
filingRule: File the motion in the original criminal case with the circuit court clerk, tendering AOC-334 as the proposed order.
submissionDestination: Office of the Circuit Court Clerk, in the original criminal case in the county of conviction, as motion type SA with no summons issued.
profileCorroborationNote: None available. The compiled KY profile records five pathways (KRS 431.078, KRS 431.073, KRS 431.076 and two juvenile routes) and does not mention KRS 218A.276, KRS 27A.099 or AOC-334.
